title: Asking the world what is there
summary: The training yard gets a watchtower. Learn to put a question to the world with a line, a swept shape, or a trace through many things, choose what counts as an answer by channel or by object type, and draw every trace so you can see it, then build a rangefinder, a sentry's eye, a gate that will not crush anyone, a shot that pierces thin things, and a bouncing laser, all wired into a tower that raises an alarm and shuts the gate.
